name: 七人原的第七个人
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:768
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜不露身份，手里没东西｜1档｜七人里最高的塔尔森是极境，第七人页上没写位阶，照一身旧灰斗篷、满手老茧估灵格；家里穷，手里拿的什么没人记得，所以只有斗篷、缠布护臂，两手空着，不起兵器。
who: The seventh of the seven on the plain, a traveller who never gave a name: medium height, about 170 cm, lean and wiry, of no clear age. Always wrapped in an old faded grey cloak with a deep hood pulled very low, so that only the lower half of the face and the two hands are ever seen: a plain, ordinary chin and a closed mouth, a lean androgynous look, no beard. The hands are ordinary hands, calloused at the knuckles from many years of work. Nothing else shows: no jewellery, no crest, no visible weapon. A quiet, patient, unobtrusive air; the one who sits farthest from the fire.
face: FACE, as in the references: the hood is pulled so low that its shadow covers the eyes and the brow in every figure; only the lower half of a plain, ordinary, androgynous face shows, a neat chin and a closed mouth; no beard.
build: 170 cm, lean and wiry: narrow shoulders under the cloak, work-hardened hands.
palette: faded ash grey, undyed wool brown, dull leather, a little smoke white
casual: On the road: an old faded grey wool cloak with a deep hood pulled low over the face, fastened at the throat with a plain wooden toggle and falling to the shins; under it a plain undyed wool tunic belted with a leather strap, dark trousers, old worn boots. Both bare, calloused hands hold a wooden bowl in front of the chest. He stands a little apart, quiet.
private: At the far edge of the waystation: the same grey cloak, the hood still pulled low, opened at the front over the plain wool tunic, the boots muddy; the bare hands loosely clasped in front, a quiet, patient stance.
battle: Rising last to follow the others out toward the bleached grass: the old grey cloak fastened tight at the throat, the hood still pulled low over the eyes, strips of plain leather bound round both forearms over the tunic sleeves, the belt cinched, the old boots laced high; no armour, no crest and nothing in the hands, both bare calloused hands open at the sides.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing upright and ready, the feet set apart, both bare hands open and empty at the sides, the hood low over the eyes; holding nothing at all.
formal: In the one clean set of clothes he owns: the same old grey cloak brushed clean, the hood still pulled low, a fresh plain undyed wool tunic, a strip of undyed linen tied at the waist; the hands folded in front. He stands still and quiet.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the hood pulled low so its shadow hides the eyes, only the plain chin and closed mouth lit, one calloused hand holding the hood's edge at the throat. Warm firelight from below on one side, cold grey rain light from the other. Foreground blur: streaks of rain and a wisp of steam from a wooden bowl.
